summary: First backend test iteration for AMASS API. Ran 21 pytest cases covering health, auth (register/login/me), properties (list, filters, single, 404), favorites (auth-gated toggle on/off, ids, list), marketplace (all + category filters), neighborhoods, AI Claude Sonnet 4.5 sync search, and seed idempotency. All 21 tests pass (100%). No _id leakage detected on any resource. AI /api/ai/search/sync returned a non-empty reply from Claude Sonnet 4.5 via Emergent Universal Key.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 731 lines — approaching the 700-line threshold. Consider splitting into modules (auth.py, properties.py, favorites.py, marketplace.py, neighborhoods.py, ai.py, seed.py) before it grows further.
SEED_PROPERTIES uses inline dicts — the 9th 'Sold - Elegant Terrace' entry has no agent_avatar or ai_valuation (minor, not a bug, but inconsistent).
Startup event uses deprecated @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown'). FastAPI recommends lifespan context managers now — no functional bug, cosmetic upgrade.
JWT_SECRET has a hardcoded dev fallback in code even though .env sets it — safe for now (env is used) but consider requiring it without fallback in production.
verify_password swallows all exceptions with bare except — acceptable for bcrypt, but consider logging invalid hash format for debuggability.
seed_data_creation: Registered 2 transient TEST_user_* users via /api/auth/register during testing; cleaned up from Mongo after tests (deletedCount=2). Demo user demo@amass.africa already existed via startup seed / prior registration and was reused.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 21 backend tests are green. Test file lives at /app/backend/tests/test_amass_api.py with shared fixtures in conftest.py. Reuse the demo_token / auth_headers fixtures for any new authed tests. Note: backend lowercases emails on register and rejects reserved TLDs like .test — use @example.com for new test users. AI test hits Claude Sonnet 4.5 and takes ~3–6s.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs found. Two initial test-side issues were fixed by the testing agent: (1) pydantic EmailStr rejects .test TLD → switched to @example.com; (2) backend lowercases email on storage → assertion updated to compare with email.lower().
